purpose: official primary API reference URLs consulted through web tool before implementation; tool produced no extractable source text in this session, so paraphrases below are implementation assumptions separately validated by actual native tests, not a quoted-document proof

sources.paraphrase: CloseHandle consumes a valid open handle on nonzero return. Zero is failure with GetLastError; invalid/pseudo handles may raise debugger exceptions. Each owned handle must be closed once, not tested later using a potentially reused numeric value.

A test may set HANDLE_FLAG_PROTECT_FROM_CLOSE on its own exact handle to make CloseHandle decline to close it. This is process-local handle state, not a token/ACL/machine-policy change. Do not clear the flag or retry after the intentional failure.
